title: Coral Nautilus
description: Have you ever thought that, Hey! There should be a Coral Nautilus just like the Zombie Coral Nautilus. Well, this mod adds just that!
body:
# Coral Nautilus
Have you ever thought, "There should be a Coral Nautilus to match the Zombie Coral Nautilus!" If so, this mod is for you!

This mod adds the Coral Nautilus, a new variant of the Nautilus inspired by Minecraft's existing Zombie Coral Nautilus. It fits naturally into the game and expands the variety of aquatic creatures you'll encounter while exploring the oceans.

The Coral Nautilus can be found spawning in Warm Ocean biomes, making those vibrant waters feel even more alive. It behaves similarly to other Nautilus variants, blending seamlessly into the vanilla experience while adding a fresh new mob to discover.

Whether you're looking to make your oceans feel more diverse or just think the Coral Nautilus should have existed all along, this mod is a simple addition that fits right in.

# Features
🐚 Adds the Coral Nautilus as a new Nautilus variant.

🌊 Naturally spawns in Warm Ocean biomes.

🎮 Designed to fit the vanilla Minecraft style.
# Requirements
GeckoLib (required)
